6→7: ESM required: set "type": "module" in package.json and target ESNext modules in tsconfig
New generator: use the `prisma-client` provider (not `prisma-client-js`); the `output` path is now required and the client is no longer emitted into node_modules
Explicit driver adapters required for every datasource (e.g. @prisma/adapter-pg, @prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3)
New prisma.config.ts config file at the project root (datasource URL, schema location, migrations)
Environment variables are no longer auto-loaded — load .env explicitly (e.g. with dotenv)
Removed CLI flags --skip-generate and --skip-seed; generate and seed no longer run automatically after migrations
Client middleware ($use) removed — use Client Extensions ($extends) instead
Stricter TLS: invalid certificates are no longer ignored by default
